bundle.shortDescription: Transcribe Persian audio locally, then explore it with AI
bundle.longDescription: What Was That About transcribes Persian audio and video on your computer with Taraneh-WLarge (Whisper, GPU) or Shenava Koochik (CPU), lets you read along while it plays, search everything you've recorded, and—optionally, with an OpenRouter key—summarize, tag, chapter and ask questions about it.
